cohort: 198 term and late preterm infants born via cesarean section in Turkey
finding: Partially hydrolyzed synbiotic formula led to better weight gain in the first month of life compared to standard formula in C-section delivered infants, with no difference in growth parameters between the groups from 1 to 3 months of age.
mod_finding: This study found that infants born via C-section who were fed a partially hydrolyzed synbiotic formula had better weight gain during the first month of life compared to those fed standard formula, and this weight gain was similar to infants who were exclusively breastfed.
